SELECT h.owner_id,h.task_id,h.revision,h.action,h.created_at AS occurred_at,t.id AS owned_task_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.id')) AS snapshot_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.revision')) AS snapshot_revision, JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.revision')) AS snapshot_revision_type, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.status')) AS status, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.completedAt')) AS completed_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.updatedAt')) AS updated_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.createdAt')) AS created_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.startedAt')) AS started_at, JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.target')) AS target_type, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.target.itemId')) AS target_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.target.versionId')) AS target_version_id, v.id AS owned_target_version_id,p.task_id AS previous_task_id,p.revision AS previous_revision, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.snapshot_json,'$.status')) AS previous_status, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.snapshot_json,'$.completedAt')) AS previous_completed_at, (JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(h.snapshot_json,'all','$.id','$.revision','$.status','$.completedAt','$.updatedAt','$.createdAt','$.startedAt','$.target')=1 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.id'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.revision'))='INTEGER' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.status'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.completedAt'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.updatedAt'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.createdAt'))='STRING' AND (JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.startedAt'))='NULL' OR (JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.startedAt'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.startedAt'))<>'null')) AND (JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.target'))='NULL' OR (JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.target'))='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.target.itemId'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.target.versionId'))='STRING')) AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.snapshot_json,'$.status'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.snapshot_json,'$.completedAt'))='NULL') AS metadata_types_valid FROM preparation_task_history h LEFT JOIN preparation_task t ON t.owner_id=h.owner_id AND t.id=h.task_id LEFT JOIN preparation_task_history p ON p.owner_id=h.owner_id AND p.task_id=h.task_id AND p.revision=h.revision-1 LEFT JOIN preparation_item i ON i.owner_id=h.owner_id AND i.kind='TARGET' AND i.id=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.target.itemId')) LEFT JOIN preparation_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.snapshot_json,'$.target.versionId')) WHERE h.owner_id=#{owner} AND
(h.task_id=#{key.taskId} AND h.revision=#{key.revision})
